summary.text: Jennifer Long is the Libertarian candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 77, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as lawyer, and in a 2026 survey she cited 10 years of healthcare experience and nearly five years on the Lansing Township Downtown Development Authority board.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Jennifer Long said she holds a law degree from Western Michigan Cooley Law School and has years of involvement in homeless outreach.
She advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
Long listed her campaign messages as lower taxes, responsible spending and housing affordability; governmental accountability and transparency; and privacy and constitutional rights.
She said she believes government should be limited to protecting individual rights, maintaining essential public services and ensuring fair and consistent laws.
